dish.note: Fizzy lemonade turned pool blue with blue raspberry syrup, poured over plenty of ice.
dish.how: Stir the lemon juice and sugar until the sugar dissolves. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, add 1 tbsp blue raspberry syrup to each, pour in the lemon mix and top with cold soda water. Stir once.
dish.make_ahead: Mix the lemon and sugar up to a day ahead and chill; build each glass to serve

steps.text: Stir the lemon juice and sugar until dissolved.
Fill glasses with ice, add the blue syrup and lemon mix, top with soda and stir.
